title: XCP CAN FD Data Acquisition
text: Acquire selected measurements from configured server connection, 1 output, {Block Output Settings} sets the port output as Compu method conversion values or raw values Raw values as double; {Config name} sets the xCP CAN FD session name select, {Event name} selects an event select, {All Measurements} sets the list all measurements available for event measurements, {Selected Measurements} sets the list selected measurements measurement, {DAQ List Priority} sets a priority value for server device driver priority, {Sample time} sets the sampling time of block and {Enable Timestamp} enables reading timestamp from incoming DTO. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Data
ports.summary: Output measurement samples defined by A2L file

params.name: Config name
params.values: Specify XCP CAN FD session name select from list

params.name: Event name
params.values: Select an event select from list

params.name: All Measurements
params.values: List all measurements available for event measurements list

params.name: Block Output Settings
params.values: Set the port output as Compu method conversion values or raw values Raw values as double (no Compu method conversion) (default) | Raw values (no Compu method conversion) | Physical values (apply Compu method conversion)

params.name: DAQ List Priority
params.values: Specify a priority value for server device driver priority value

params.name: Enable Timestamp
params.values: Enable reading timestamp from incoming DTO packets off (default) | on
